from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import logging
from collections.abc import Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models import Prefetch, QuerySet
from django.utils import timezone
from django.utils.dateparse import parse_datetime

from events.media_services import MediaStorageService
from events.models import Event, EventMedia

from .models import (
    FrameDevice,
    FrameDeviceSession,
    FrameEventTag,
    FrameMediaTag,
    FrameTag,
)

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from django.contrib.auth.models import AbstractBaseUser

User = get_user_model()


logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class FeedItem:
    id: str
    type: str
    payload: dict[str, Any]


class FrameAuthenticationService:
    """Helpers to ensure each device has a backing auth user and session."""

    @staticmethod
    @transaction.atomic
    def ensure_device_user(device: FrameDevice) -> AbstractBaseUser:
        """Create or fetch the service user tied to this device."""
        if device.auth_user and device.auth_user.is_active:
            return device.auth_user

        username = f"frame-{device.id}"
        email = f"{username}@frames.local"
        user, created = User.objects.get_or_create(
            username=username,
            defaults={
                "email": email,
                "is_active": True,
                "is_staff": False,
                "is_superuser": False,
            },
        )
        if created:
            user.set_unusable_password()
            user.save(update_fields=["password"])

        device.auth_user = user
        device.save(update_fields=["auth_user"])
        return user

    @staticmethod
    @transaction.atomic
    def record_session(device: FrameDevice, refresh_token) -> FrameDeviceSession:
        """Persist refresh token metadata for revocation tracking."""
        jti = str(refresh_token["jti"])
        expiry = timezone.make_aware(datetime.fromtimestamp(int(refresh_token["exp"])))
        session, _created = FrameDeviceSession.objects.update_or_create(
            device=device,
            refresh_token_jti=jti,
            defaults={
                "refresh_token_expiry": expiry,
                "is_active": True,
                "last_refreshed": timezone.now(),
                "revoked_at": None,
            },
        )
        return session

import logging
from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

import stripe
from django.conf import settings
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.utils import timezone

from payments.models import (
    Invoice,
    PaymentEvent,
    PaymentMethod,
    StripeCustomer,
    Subscription,
    SubscriptionTier,
)
from users.models import FamilyGroup

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _get_subscription_period(
    stripe_subscription: stripe.Subscription | dict[str, Any],
) -> tuple[datetime, datetime]:
    """Extract current period from Stripe subscription items.

    Stripe API v2025+ removed current_period_start/end from the top-level
    Subscription object. These fields now live on subscription items.
    """
    item = stripe_subscription["items"]["data"][0]
    period_start = datetime.fromtimestamp(item["current_period_start"])
    period_end = datetime.fromtimestamp(item["current_period_end"])
    return (
        timezone.make_aware(period_start),
        timezone.make_aware(period_end),
    )


class StripeService:
    """Service class for all Stripe-related operations"""

    @staticmethod
    def initialize_stripe():
        """Initialize Stripe with API key using lazy initialization.

        This method ensures the API key is only set when needed, preventing
        exposure of sensitive credentials in module-level initialization.
        """
